bullets: Fixed a prior double-count where cache reads were added again on top of prompt_tokens, which already includes the cached prefix, so reported token totals now match actual model input.
Updated GLM 5.3 Flash reasoning effort ladder to offer only low and high, removing the max rung because deeper reasoning caused the model to stall on agent tasks instead of converging.
Added an upgrade call-to-action to session limit screens in the CLI landing screen so walled free users can reach a paid plan directly from quota and spend refusals.
Switched thinker-gemini agent from Google Gemini 3.1 Pro preview to DeepSeek V4 Flash with high reasoning enabled, due to credit grant expiration and cost savings.
Lowered the minimum billing rate for ad clicks in low-conversion countries from 50 cents to 10 cents, monetizing inventory that would otherwise go unmonetized.
Pinned Solar Pro 4 to one session per day on the Freebuff free tier, backed by a dollar ceiling, after uncapped usage caused a 70x spike on 2026-08-31.
Added placementSurface resolver to map placement ids to their surface and fill missing surface fields, preventing null errors in ad delivery and click settlement.
Now renders compact duration strings like 24 hrs on secondary UI lines while keeping full words in headlines.
Forced god quota exempt flag on in the SDK test setup to prevent production config from breaking exemption tests.
Added terminal command broker and diff collection controls to CodebuffRunner for sponsored coding evals, keeping sensitive paths out of collected diffs.
Added MRC50 viewability tracking constants and helpers to common, firing a viewable event when an element stays 50% visible for one second.
Added frequency reservation detail fields to the ad decision logging schema for better insight into slot availability.
Added sponsored proposal channel logic to common for turning proposal rows into rendering-agnostic view models with safe URL handling.
Updated GLM 5.2 referral reward to be tier-shaped, unlocking the reward model at limited access and adding a session at full access.
Released CLI package version 0.0.165 with planned improvements for paid and free tier users.
